answer: Locks are recorded in cedar, expire in mirror, and bridge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 146 aliases therefore needs 189 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1831 identities would post 612 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
